text: If you took the sankalpam for a ten-day puja, don't do this step today — do it tomorrow, once the Vijayadashami puja is complete.
If you did not set up a kalasham, this step isn't needed.
Join your hands before the kalasham and pray to the Devi.
Amma, our namaskarams to you for accepting our pujas this Navaratri.
We pray that your grace is always upon our family.
